name: Danang Marriott Resort & Spa
short_description: Marriott Hotels beachfront resort on Da Nang's Non Nuoc Beach (formerly Vinpearl Luxury), with 239 rooms and suites, five pools and Quan Spa set opposite the Marble Mountains.
ai_summary: Danang Marriott Resort & Spa is a beachfront five-star property on Non Nuoc Beach in the Ngu Hanh Son district, roughly 15 km south of Da Nang and opposite the Marble Mountains. Formerly Vinpearl Luxury Da Nang, it was rebranded under Marriott Bonvoy in September 2022 and comprises 239 guest rooms and suites in the main building. Independent reviewers consistently praise the spacious accommodations, many with private balconies and sweeping ocean and pool views, and single out the warm, attentive service, with staff greetings and personalized housekeeping notes cited repeatedly. The five outdoor pools, including two central infinity pools, and the wide, well-kept beach are recurring highlights, as is a generous breakfast buffet blending international and Vietnamese dishes at Goji Kitchen + Bar, complemented by refined Vietnamese cuisine at Madame Son and beachfront seafood grills. Suite guests gain Executive Lounge access. Honest watch-outs recur: the setting is peaceful but isolated, around 15 to 20 minutes from central Da Nang, so dining beyond the resort requires a drive; some interiors show their age given the property's pre-Marriott history; and the main breakfast venue can feel small and noisy at peak times. With a solid TripAdvisor base and broad independent coverage, it reads as a relaxed, family-friendly beach resort best suited to travelers prioritizing beach, pools and service over nightlife or a central location.

faqs.question: Where is Danang Marriott Resort & Spa located and how far is the airport?
faqs.answer: The resort sits on Non Nuoc Beach in the Ngu Hanh Son district of Da Nang, roughly 15 km (about 20 minutes) from Da Nang International Airport. It faces the Marble Mountains and is a short drive from both central Da Nang and Hoi An Ancient Town.

faqs.question: Is this the same property as the Non Nuoc Beach Villas?
faqs.answer: No. This listing is the main resort building, offering guest rooms and suites, including Executive Ocean Suites with lounge access. The Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas is a separate all-villa property with private-pool villas booked under its own listing, though both share the same beachfront complex.

faqs.question: What are the dining and pool facilities like?
faqs.answer: The resort has five outdoor pools, including two central infinity pools, plus a spacious white-sand beach. Dining spans Goji Kitchen + Bar for international buffets, Madame Son for refined Vietnamese cuisine and beachfront seafood grills, with an extensive breakfast praised for its international and Vietnamese variety.
